# VoluChat

> Autonomous AI sales agent on WhatsApp for fashion & clothing boutiques. Closes sales, qualifies sizing, recovers abandoned carts, drives upsells, and completes in-chat UPI checkout — 24/7, no human intervention needed.

VoluChat is an AI sales stylist that operates inside Instagram DMs and WhatsApp conversations. It captures leads from Instagram comments on fashion Reels, qualifies buyer sizing & fit, answers fabric questions using live catalog inventory, and completes orders with native in-chat UPI payment.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.voluchat.com): Main site with live demo and pilot signup
